title: "The annual ship register checked"

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(nanoparquet)
# quarto sets the working directory to this file's own; R/paths.R is the
# single place that resolves $FISHYDATA, and nothing here hardcodes a data path.
source("../R/paths.R")
disc <- read_parquet(fd_curated("check", "skipaskra_discrepancy.parquet"))
agr  <- read_parquet(fd_curated("check", "skipaskra_agreement.parquet"))
dec  <- read_parquet(fd_curated("vessel", "skipaskra", "decision.parquet"))
regd <- read_parquet(fd_curated("vessel", "skipaskra", "registered.parquet"))
ucp  <- read_parquet(fd_curated("vessel", "skipaskra", "usage_category_printed.parquet"))
n_rule <- function(r, st = NULL) sum(dec$rule %in% r & (is.null(st) | dec$status %in% st))
n_of <- function(k) sum(disc$check == k)
fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
pdf_agr <- agr |> filter(anchor == "pdf")
pct <- function(d) round(100 * sum(d$n_agree) / sum(d$n), 1)
MEASURES <- c("length", "max_length", "width", "depth", "brutto_grt", "brutto_weight_tons", "power", "construction_year")
idn  <- disc |> filter(check == "identical_editions")
cnt_eds <- disc |> filter(check == "total", grepl("^n_", column)) |> pull(edition) |> unique() |> sort()
saga_names <- disc |> filter(check == "witness_value", column == "name", grepl("skipasaga", source_other), !is.na(edition))
list13 <- disc |> filter(check == "number_list", edition == 2013, column == "name")
two <- disc |> filter(check == "call_sign_two_hulls")
key <- function(x) gsub("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]", "", toupper(x), perl = TRUE)
ff <- disc |> filter(check == "fixed_field")
cut_short <- startsWith(key(ff$value), key(ff$value_other)) | startsWith(key(ff$value_other), key(ff$value))
WHAT <- c(
  total = "entries against the edition's own count and GT",
  table_sum = "a trend table's decked + open against its total",
  number_list = "the register against its number list (2004-2013)",
  callsign_list = "the register against its call-sign list (2004-2013)",
  aggregate_class = "entries by classification society against the inspection table",
  aggregate_events = "the year's lists against the trend table",
  rule_callsign_short = "a call sign below 15 m length overall",
  rule_imo_check_digit = "an IMO number that fails its check digit",
  rule_imo_missing = "no IMO number above 24 m registered length",
  rule_gt_formula = "GT off 0.031 L² B below 15 m",
  rule_nt_formula = "NT off 0.3 GT below 15 m",
  rule_year_after_edition = "a build or engine year after the edition",
  vocabulary = "a value outside the key's lists (mostly a type cut short in print)",
  unique_call_sign = "one call sign on two hulls in one edition",
  unique_district = "one district number on two hulls in one edition",
  identical_editions = "an edition that repeats the one before",
  fixed_field = "build year, place, yard, IMO or hull material changing between editions",
  change_unexplained = "a dimension or tonnage change with no note and no dated change",
  left_unlisted = "a hull that left with no deregistration listed",
  arrived_unlisted = "a hull that came with no registration listed",
  deregistered_still_printed = "a deregistered hull printed the next year",
  registered_not_printed = "a registered hull missing the next year",
  first_registration_seen_before = "a first registration of a hull printed before",
  trend = "a trend-table figure that differs from most editions'",
  witness_value = "a PDF value no witness of the same date agrees with",
  witness_undated = "kvoti.skip_extra's fixed fields against every edition",
  call_sign_two_hulls = "one call sign on two hulls at once, in one witness",
  mmsi_unregistered = "an MMSI first held in a year the hull is off the register",
  mmsi_after_register = "an MMSI held more than a year after the hull's last edition",
  mmsi_mbl_not_in_archive = "mbl's MMSI not in the archive",
  mmsi_list_2023 = "the 2023-01-15 MMSI list against the archive",
  licence_non_fishing = "a fishing licence on a ship of a non-fishing type",
  licence_after_deregistration = "a licence issued after the hull's last deregistration",
  activity_unregistered = "landings or logbook trips in a year the hull is off the register",
  activity_after_deregistration = "fishing after a listed deregistration",
  activity_before_registration = "fishing before a listed registration",
  landing_without_licence = "a landing with no licence valid on the day (to 2020-07-22)",
  gear_without_licence = "Danish seine or lumpfish nets without their licence (to 2020-07-22)")
```

*Checked and built with AI assistance (Claude), plan 028 steps 4-5, 2026-10-18. A check only finds: its findings stay
"unsettled". The history (step 5, below) chooses every value by the decision model of plan 028 §6, and its `decision`
table says how each was settled.*

## The short version

The annual register PDFs, 19 editions from 2004 to 2022 (decision 130), were checked in four ways: inside each
edition, between editions, against every other witness, and against landings and logbooks.
`r length(unique(disc$check))` of `r length(WHAT)` checks found something, `r fmt(nrow(disc))` findings in all. Nothing
in the PDFs or any other source is changed by them.

- **The witnesses agree with the PDFs on measures:** `r pct(pdf_agr |> filter(column %in% MEASURES))` % of lengths,
  breadths, depths, tonnages, kW and build years. They agree on names and districts less often:
  `r pct(pdf_agr |> filter(column %in% c("name", "region_acronym", "region_no"), grepl("skipasaga", witness)))` % for
  the Directorate of Fisheries' ship history. In `r fmt(sum(grepl("earlier edition", saga_names$detail)))` of its
  `r fmt(nrow(saga_names))` disagreements on a name, that history gives the name the register printed for the hull
  in an earlier edition: it keeps an old name.
- **The `vessel` schema's history before 2023-12-19 has no call sign at all.** Its back-filled engine rows also hold
  the engine type ("D") where the make belongs. For 2004-2022 the call signs come only from the PDFs, kvoti's copy of
  the register and the ufs journal.
- **The `r idn$edition` edition reprints `r sub("pdf:", "", idn$source_other)`'s register:** `r idn$value_other` of its
  entries are exactly as in `r sub("pdf:", "", idn$source_other)`.
- **2013's number list is newer than its register.** It names `r nrow(list13)` hulls differently from the register,
  and `r sum(grepl("later edition", list13$detail))` of those names are the hull's name in a later edition.

## Findings by check

```{r}
#| echo: false
tibble(check = names(WHAT), what = unname(WHAT)) |>
  left_join(disc |> count(kind, check), by = "check") |>
  mutate(n = coalesce(n, 0L), kind = coalesce(kind, "")) |>
  select(kind, check, what, findings = n) |>
  knitr::kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## The PDFs against each witness

Each PDF value is compared with every value a witness gives for the same hull and column on the edition's 1 January.
Numbers agree when equal at the coarser of the two precisions. Text is compared on its letters and digits, so case,
spaces and stops do not count. Witnesses are grouped by where they come from, as in plan 028 §6.1: copies of one
database agree only as a copy.

```{r}
#| echo: false
pdf_agr |>
  group_by(witness, column) |>
  summarise(values = sum(n), agree = round(100 * sum(n_agree) / sum(n), 1),
            `agree within half a year` = round(100 * sum(n_agree_in_time) / sum(n), 1), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(witness, column) |>
  knitr::kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

Where a witness disagrees with the PDF but agrees within half a year, the difference is in the dating, not the value.
Step 5 dates such changes from the dated sources.

## What the findings say

- **Inside an edition.**
  - Entries differ from the edition's own count in `r paste(cnt_eds, collapse = ", ")`. That is the gaps decision
    130 found. The GT totals differ in
    `r paste(sort(unique(disc$edition[disc$check == "total" & grepl("^gt_", disc$column)])), collapse = ", ")`.
  - Of the key's rules, the GT formula below 15 m is broken most often (`r fmt(n_of("rule_gt_formula"))` entries),
    then call signs on boats below 15 m (`r fmt(n_of("rule_callsign_short"))`).
  - `r n_of("rule_imo_check_digit")` IMO numbers fail their check digit as printed.
- **Between editions.**
  - `r n_of("fixed_field")` times a build year, place, yard, IMO or hull material differs from the hull's other
    editions. In `r sum(cut_short)` of them one value is the other cut short in print;
    `r sum(disc$check == "fixed_field" & disc$column == "imo_no")` are IMO numbers.
  - `r n_of("change_unexplained")` changes in a dimension or tonnage have neither a changes note nor a dated change in
    another source.
  - The lists of registrations and deregistrations miss `r n_of("left_unlisted") + n_of("arrived_unlisted")` hulls that
    left or came.
  - `r sum(disc$check == "deregistered_still_printed" & disc$edition == 2013)` of the
    `r n_of("deregistered_still_printed")` hulls listed as deregistered but printed the next year are in 2013, and
    `r sum(disc$check == "registered_not_printed" & disc$edition == 2013)` of the `r n_of("registered_not_printed")`
    listed as registered but not printed.
- **Against the witnesses.**
  - `r fmt(n_of("witness_value"))` PDF values have no agreeing witness on their date.
  - `r fmt(n_of("call_sign_two_hulls"))` times a witness gives one call sign to two hulls at once. In
    `r fmt(sum(grepl("last printed (200|201|202[01])|in no edition", two$detail)))` of them one of the two hulls had
    left the register before 2022: the witness keeps the sign on a hull that is gone while another holds it. Most
    such rows come from the `vessel` schema, from 2023-12-19, and kvoti's register copy.
- **Against activity.**
  - `r n_of("activity_unregistered")` vessel-years have landings or logbook trips while the hull is in neither edition
    around them.
  - `r n_of("gear_without_licence")` vessel-years land from Danish seine or lumpfish nets without that licence.

## The history to 2023-12-19

The history keeps a value only while the hull is on the register.
- `r fmt(nrow(regd))` runs on the register cover `r fmt(n_distinct(regd$registration_no))` hulls.
- `r sum(regd$window_from == "dated")` of the runs' starts and `r sum(regd$window_to == "dated")` of their ends take a
  day from a list, a first registration or the `vessel` schema. The rest are known to the year.
- `r sum(regd$window_to == "open")` runs reach 2023-12-19, where the `vessel` schema's own history takes over.

Each column's value is chosen stretch by stretch, by the period's source and the rules of plan 028 §6:

```{r}
#| echo: false
dec |> mutate(rule = coalesce(rule, "")) |> count(table, status) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  knitr::kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

- **D3, the period's source,** settled `r fmt(n_rule("D3"))` stretches where the lineages disagree.
- **D2, the register's own rules:** `r n_rule("D2", "resolved")` stretches took another lineage's value that keeps the
  rule, and `r n_rule("D2", "open")` stay as printed, open, with no such value.
- **D4, the typo rule,** decided `r n_rule("D4")`. It needs two lineages besides the register's to agree, and with
  Hreiðar inside the register's lineage for 2004-2021 (decision 135) that is almost never the case.
- **D1, a person's decision,** decided `r n_rule("D1")`. None is entered yet.
- **D5, dating:** `r fmt(sum(dec$window_from == "dated"))` stretches start on a known day, and
  `r fmt(sum(dec$window_from == "annual"))` within a known year.
- **Types of ship:** `r round(100 * sum(ucp$entries[ucp$basis != "none"]) / sum(ucp$entries))` % of the printed types
  map to the `vessel` schema's codes. The rest are cut short in print.

## Not checked here

- **AIS.** That comes later, and only through what the feed broadcasts itself (plan 028 §5.4).
- **Changes the editions do not show.** Between two editions the history dates a change (D5) but adds none.
- **Owners' addresses.** The sources write them in different grammatical cases, with or without postcode and town.
- **Personal data.** Owners' names are compared, but this page shows only counts. The rows stay under `$FISHYDATA`.
